notes: Described in search results as the only ACNA parish in Tucson; formerly Joy Faith Anglican Church. It is a meeting-in-borrowed-space congregation (Mystic Rhythms Ballroom at Oracle and Magee in one listing, the Chapel Hall of Canyon Del Oro Bible Church in another), so the meeting address is unstable - confirm before plotting. A search snippet said a rector named 'Blake' accepted the call in October 2024 but gave no surname, so no pastor is recorded. Sermon audio is published on the church site.
